task: put both the alphabet soup and the cream cheese box in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue box.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the alphabet soup can.
Approach the alphabet soup can from above, lowering the open gripper toward its top.
Approach the alphabet soup can from above, lowering the open gripper around its top.
Approach the alphabet soup can from above, lowering the open gripper around its sides.
Grasp the alphabet soup can and lift it vertically off the table.
Lift the alphabet soup can up off the table, moving it toward the basket.
Carry the alphabet soup can horizontally toward the basket.
Carry the alphabet soup can horizontally over the table toward the basket.
Lower the alphabet soup can down into the basket.
Release the alphabet soup can into the basket.
Release the alphabet soup can into the basket and retract the empty gripper upward.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue box.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue cream cheese box.
Approach the blue cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese box on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, raising it above the surface.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, moving it toward the basket.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, away from the basket.
Carry the blue box horizontally toward the basket.
Lower the cream cheese box down into the basket.
Release the blue box into the basket.
Release the blue box into the basket and open the gripper.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the basket.
